headline: Fusion CX opens today (anchors ₹315 Cr, MF-heavy) — neutral. HD Fire closes tomorrow: Retail 2.84x, still Apply Retail. Zetwerk, Bonfiglioli, Tonbo, Sahajanand open 15 Oct.

hd-fire-protect.category_note: Day 2 AM: Retail 2.84x beats sNII 8.96x / bNII 6.76x; 1 lot per family PAN; recheck at close 15 Oct
hd-fire-protect.summary: India's #2 fire-protection equipment maker and largest exporter (sprinklers, deluge valves, foam systems), with the most UL/FM certifications among Indian peers.
hd-fire-protect.financials: FY26 revenue ₹489 Cr (+13%), PAT ₹117 Cr, EBITDA margin 31%, debt-free
positives: Certification moat and 30% RoE; priced at 40.7x vs peer average 63x
Strong anchor book: ₹213 Cr, 72% to HDFC/ICICI Pru/Kotak/ABSL MFs
red_flags: 100% OFS — promoters selling, company gets nothing
₹196 Cr dividends to promoters in the last two years
PAT growth slowed to 6% in FY26; inventory days rising
hd-fire-protect.anchor: ₹213 Cr from 25 anchors: HDFC MF, ICICI Pru, Kotak, ABSL MF, Mirae, UTI, Allianz

tonbo-imaging.category_note: GMP ~70% (₹490); anchor book due today — only if it's strong
tonbo-imaging.summary: Bengaluru defence-electronics maker: thermal imaging cores, weapon sights, targeting and missile-seeker systems; ~71% of revenue from the Indian government.
tonbo-imaging.financials: FY26 revenue ₹363 Cr (−23%), PAT ₹51 Cr (−30%); Q1 FY27 loss ₹17.7 Cr
positives: Owned, ITAR-free technology; #1 in Indian thermal imaging; ₹314 Cr order book
Very strong GMP (~68%) and defence-theme demand
red_flags: Revenue and profit falling; operating cash flow negative two years running
Working-capital days 517; inventory tripled in two years
79x P/E on falling earnings; 100% OFS; promoters hold only 17%
tonbo-imaging.anchor: Anchor bidding today (14 Oct); list not out at 09:00 IST

sahajanand-medical-technologies.summary: Surat-based maker of cardiac stents and structural-heart devices (TAVI, occluders); ~25% share of India's drug-eluting stent market, ~39% revenue from Europe.
sahajanand-medical-technologies.financials: FY26 revenue ₹1,211 Cr (+18%), PAT ₹69 Cr (5.7% margin); FY24 was a loss
positives: Real product franchise with 16% revenue CAGR and improving margins
red_flags: 53x P/E vs 44x peers on thin 14% EBITDA margin
Net debt/EBITDA 4.9x; Q1 operating cash flow negative
100% OFS with PE funds exiting; Delhi Police and CBI notices seeking documents
sahajanand-medical-technologies.anchor: Anchor bidding today (14 Oct); list not out at 09:00 IST

fusion-cx.category_note: GMP ₹33.5 (~12%); opens today — check Retail demand at close 16 Oct (10% retail quota)
fusion-cx.summary: Customer-experience (CX/BPO) outsourcer with 40 delivery centres in 13 countries; telecom is 47% of revenue.
fusion-cx.financials: FY26 revenue ₹1,818 Cr (+37%), PAT ₹170 Cr (2.3x), RoNW 31%
positives: Fast growth with operating cash flow ₹264 Cr above PAT ₹170 Cr
21.5x P/E vs peer average 26.7x; ₹500 Cr fresh issue, ₹276 Cr repays debt
red_flags: Top-10 customers ≈50% of revenue; acquisition-led growth (goodwill ₹363 Cr)
Promoters hold 96% and sell ₹202 Cr in the OFS; tiny 10% retail quota
fusion-cx.anchor: ₹315 Cr at ₹289; ~78% domestic MFs (Kotak, ICICI Pru, Motilal Oswal), Kotak Life, Kacholia's Bengal Finance

zetwerk.category_note: Listing-gain trade only; GMP ~15%; decide after anchor book (today) and subscription
zetwerk.summary: Tech-led manufacturing platform (energy, precision, capital goods) with 26 own plants and ~7,000 suppliers; ₹5,012 Cr issue.
zetwerk.financials: FY26 revenue ₹15,913 Cr (+40%), adj. EBITDA 2.7%, net loss ₹1,606 Cr
positives: Revenue +40% in FY26; ₹13,062 Cr manufacturing order book
₹2,160 Cr of fresh issue repays debt; GMP ~14%
red_flags: Loss-making every year; ₹1,606 Cr loss FY26 incl. discontinued ops
No listed peer; ~60x adj. EBITDA, thin 2.7% margin
Half the issue is OFS by VC funds; only 10% retail quota
zetwerk.anchor: Anchor bidding today (14 Oct); list not out at 09:00 IST

bonfiglioli-transmissions.category_note: Leaning Apply if anchor book is strong; recheck subscription at close 19 Oct
bonfiglioli-transmissions.summary: Indian arm of Italy's Bonfiglioli: industrial gearboxes, geared motors and drives (industrial, off-highway, wind).
bonfiglioli-transmissions.financials: CY25 revenue ₹2,014 Cr (+9%), PAT ₹238 Cr (+24%), RoNW 24%, debt-free
positives: Debt-free, PAT margin 11.8% rising to 13% in H1 CY26
red_flags: 100% OFS by parent — company gets nothing
Wind ≈27–32% of revenue; industry data from company-paid report
bonfiglioli-transmissions.anchor: Anchor bidding today (14 Oct); list not out at 09:00 IST

jio-platforms.summary: Reliance's digital/telecom arm. Dates and price band not announced yet.

notes: Fusion CX anchor details from news (NSE allocation letter is a scanned PDF, unreadable).
Anchor lists for Tonbo, Zetwerk, Bonfiglioli, Sahajanand not yet public (bidding today).
Jio Platforms: no dates/price band yet, no RHP — analysis pending.
